pieces.title: Sprint kickoff - foundations
pieces.why: A repeatable candidate and visible failed gates are prerequisites for every demo claim.
acceptance: Required GitLab jobs execute the declared Node runtime, isolated Python requirements and locked web toolchain.
The local acceptance runner revalidates all eighteen profiles and retains current BLOCKED receipts when runtime provisioning fails.
The tested candidate and deployed readback share an exact source identity.
Internal submission standards stay distinct from captured official requirements.
The GitLab artifact download retains every referenced receipt, log and artifact plus the original JUnit/build paths; the shared validator rechecks their bytes.
Required native SDK/parser and portable-suite coverage checks execute in GitLab, retaining Python 3.11 and 3.12; manual submission waits for every required source job.
Review pipelines retain exactly one actor label from the current provider context; GitHub exports bind repository, review number and exact tested head. Missing metadata cannot satisfy governance.
Automatic public PR governance and required GitLab checks remain enabled; neither provider substitutes for observed candidate acceptance.

The supplemental assurance source job preserves evidence/authority and payment-boundary regressions; the opt-in full runtime matrix reports unavailable dependencies as non-passing and does not replace the eighteen-profile gate.

Career, Knowledge Unit, integrity and world-twin behavior suites are included in source acceptance; their existing per-module coverage gates run on Python 3.11 and 3.12 and block submission when incomplete.

The blocking Praxis GitLab job runs both declared profiles in fresh runner-owned loopback databases. Direct selftests reject absent, foreign or changed fixtures before authentication; deployment configuration, shared targets, proxies and redirects cannot become test authority. Missing native binaries remain blocked.

Designated release builds and both release controllers require fresh telemetry configuration and exact artifact binding before copy. Real bundler/SDK checks and live vendor readback remain separate; a local manifest cannot establish ingestion or heartbeat monitoring.
pieces.next_step: The CI owner must confirm public candidate delivery, trusted review metadata and same-revision GitLab statuses before updating required-check settings. Execute the complete governance/source matrices, isolated Praxis profiles and all eighteen acceptance profiles with retained artifacts; Cloudflare needs its separate diagnostic. Privately audit past shared test destinations without running mutating probes against them.

pieces.title: Auth and onboarding hardening
pieces.why: A judge must enter and resume the workspace using real account authority.
acceptance: Sign in, sign out and safe return navigation work in the built app.
A revoked or foreign account cannot reopen private workspace data.

Fresh and concurrent onboarding is atomic; uncertain retries recover one workspace, its chosen intent, one ERP objective and all seven planned services. Domain and business context are optional and imply no lookup or authority.

All six intents are explicit choices; the saved workspace reopens its readable objective and a starting path into existing lessons and planning. Legacy setup receipts and existing workspaces remain usable.

Rollback of the objective migration disables new objective setup while retaining existing goals, workspace links and receipts. Failure to load a confirmed workspace can be retried without resubmitting setup.
Persisted sessions require native refresh; delayed account responses cannot restore old identity. Named onboarding selects the exact returned readable workspace.
Government content and tools require current operator-approved paid membership in addition to native account and workspace access; account changes and expiry cannot reuse a stale grant.
Controller-owned same-account authentication refresh preserves in-progress work; actual session replacement, logout/relogin and identity changes fence old responses and clear private drafts.
pieces.next_step: Execute rendered objective-first onboarding and both native profiles, then demonstrate signup, an explicit intent/objective, the saved workspace's first lesson, setup recovery, password recovery and return navigation on the accepted candidate.

pieces.title: Workspace collections live
pieces.why: Persisted work and tenant isolation make the application useful beyond a visual prototype.
acceptance: The declared PocketBase versions apply the needed migrations and enforce current membership.
Saved work survives restart and denial/retry cases preserve record integrity.
Personal assistant collections deny other users including workspace administrators; protocol rollback retains records and disables commands.
Collection queries group extra predicates under the workspace filter. Foreign targets and stale account/workspace read or write results cannot appear current.
Government membership records deny ordinary raw CRUD; down/up migrations preserve receipts and keep restricted lessons fenced.

Media sessions bind native account, workspace, live room and attendance revision. Signalling/presence reject stale, revoked, foreign, unbound or closed sessions and unknown tracks; publishing additionally requires room management plus the configured allowlist. Both native profiles load media, attendance, usage and learning migrations rather than the old classroom subset.

Raw writes to legacy tutorial progress and the seven claim/editorial collections stay locked even without request hooks. Current native commands own guided completion, author/admin draft changes, publication stamps and submitting-account attribution. New browser seat reports bind seat to the authenticated account and actor_type to human; retained legacy data acquires no fabricated provenance.
pieces.next_step: Migration rollout is now validated on BOTH environments: preflighted against a disposable copy of live data, applied behind a database backup, and confirmed by an authenticated readback from a second box (production at 72 applied migrations, 79 collections, 33 lessons). Recovery is still unexercised - backups were taken but no restore has been performed, so rollback remains a claim rather than an observation. Exercise a restore onto a disposable profile and record it. The later classroom migrations (media sessions and the broadcast lesson) are not rolled out yet: execute both expanded native runtime profiles, including media-session and lesson installation, typed track responses, ownership/revocation and rollback. Have the release owner install matching backend migrations/hooks before the frontend and measure actual provider delivery and stream revocation on staging.

pieces.title: Signals pipeline MVP
pieces.why: An observed problem must retain its source as it becomes a bounded proposal.
acceptance: A current readable signal produces one unapproved proposal and source snapshot.
Revoked access, stale source versions and lost responses cannot create falsely confirmed or duplicated work.
A permitted Firecrawl capture retains exact source text, URL and digest, and unchanged captures reuse the saved signal.
Capture recovery addresses the exact receipt beyond the first page and retains one request identity after an ambiguous response.
pieces.next_step: Install the reviewed capture hooks and registered Firecrawl worker; capture a permitted real source, retry its lost response and propose the same mission once.

pieces.title: Missions - bounded-action engine
pieces.why: Work must have a fixed scope, approval and a review independent of its producer.
acceptance: Saved boundaries and approval precede action; outcomes remain terminal.
An independent-review plan rejects verification by its proposer or a selected evidence author.
Actual ERP and registered external actions bind frozen inputs, release declarations and current authority before effect.
Dispatched work is never blindly reissued after timeout or response loss.
Verification controls explain current membership, approved plan, proposer and evidence-author separation without replacing native review policy.
Government suite reads, commands, cached retries and worker completion recheck current sponsoring membership without changing ordinary mission review authority.

New native reviews persist version 1 and reach the existing value consumer. Final snapshot-enriched serialized reviews must fit the unchanged 24,000-byte field limit; historical terminal reviews are not silently rewritten or upgraded.
pieces.next_step: Use the receiving dispatch to run the native ERP effect and the registered bounded n8n operation; retain current release identity and a distinct result verifier.

pieces.title: Workflows editor
pieces.why: Ordered work and atomic observations allow failed or interrupted actions to be explained and replayed.
acceptance: Concurrent starts/decisions and retries preserve one run and one receipt per accepted step.
A recorded procedure is not represented as an external worker or n8n execution.
An explicit approval checkpoint precedes executable steps; native results and run events commit atomically.
Cancellation preserves uncertain issued work; late receipts cannot advance cancelled runs.
A durable run link reloads the current saved snapshot and revision; unavailable and foreign runs are never opened for a decision.
pieces.next_step: Execute frozen approved steps, exercise cancellation and HOLD reconciliation, and retain the actual native result alongside the run event.

pieces.title: Service connectors and provider health
pieces.why: A saved integration setting must not be mistaken for a working service connection.
acceptance: Firecrawl/n8n bindings have fresh observations for their current configuration revisions.
Disabled, stale and unavailable providers remain explicit and do not create successful activity.
Both Firecrawl and n8n have an observed successful use plus disabled, stale and unavailable-provider controls.
n8n deduplicates effect identities and reconciliation only reads an existing result.
Action forms select current configured bindings and visibly expire observed health while retaining backend registration and revision checks.
pieces.next_step: Bind both Firecrawl and n8n through the receiving owner; prove each configuration revision, health probe, bounded effect and uncertainty recovery.

pieces.title: Living Rooms and public-record bridges
pieces.why: A verified record is only worth keeping if it can reach the people it is about, under an authority stated per surface rather than a blanket key.
acceptance: Living Rooms read live projections on staging from a mounted, probed route, not merely present in the repository.
One canonical event projects outward to wiki, forum, Discord and Reddit without being restated per surface.
Each bridge carries its own bounded authority and a stated data boundary, never a generic admin key.
pieces.next_step: The rooms overlay landed on 2026-09-18 (RoomCanvas, UtilizationPanel and useRoomProjection reading staging projections). The four outward bridges remain open; bind each one with its own bounded authority and prove the data boundary it states.

pieces.title: Objectives, tasks and guild contacts
pieces.why: Objectives, tasks and contacts make the demonstrated outcome actionable for a guild working together.
acceptance: An operator can create and link an objective, task and contact in one workspace.
Foreign-workspace links and viewer writes are rejected by the backend.
Executed tasks retain immutable mission/execution/evidence links while business outcome review remains separate from task state.
Objective/contact task drilldowns and execution-linked task destinations retain workspace scope and separate task completion from outcome verification.
pieces.next_step: Run native/browser business journeys, inspect the executed task and its mission/evidence links, and review the objective outcome separately.

pieces.title: Evidence ledger and verification
pieces.why: A reviewer needs inspectable receipts and integrity checks for the exact candidate.
acceptance: Static capability, reported observations and verified readback stay distinct.
Release/provider exports reconcile to the expected SHA and artifact; missing evidence remains incomplete.
Verified review snapshots retain exact source observations; referenced evidence cannot silently change or disappear.
Native result bytes and release declaration agree with independent replay/deployment evidence.
The evidence inspector exposes the exact frozen reviewed observation, its author and reviewer, and differences from the current record.
Semantic invitations retain unresolved or conflicting owner identities; exact evidence prerequisites and historical captures cannot grant or promote authority.

Career facts preserve personal, team and agent participation; only exact independently pinned reviews support application claims, while employment duration, personal attestations and operational authority remain separate.

Complete mission exports retain original canonical content and leaf bytes for world-event interoperability. Scoped world projections deduplicate observations, preserve missing replay layers and use receiving-authenticated review pins; supplied status, trace correlation and local hashes cannot confer capability or authority.

Assessment evidence replays answers against its issuing bank and unique candidate/capability context. Passport headline wording, verification, dates and application references use compatible support; unchecked bank revisions and contradictory serialized headlines fail closed.

Integrity disagreement survives stale replay and ordering changes. Knowledge Unit mastery binds exact version/content and boolean outcomes. World review excludes known action/result actors, participants and guildmasters, including hidden predecessors, without excluding unrelated attempts.
pieces.next_step: Attempt denied evidence mutations, inspect frozen reviews, and reconcile the exact native result and release context with controller/provider captures. Supply scoped canonical owner mappings and retained captures for developmental queries; resolve identity and evidence gaps before independent progression review. Bind the real applicant identity and independently review exact career participation before compiling any personal application. The Citadel/CSEG receiver must authenticate world-event identity/read/share scope and exact review pins before connecting live provider references or publishing a projection.

pieces.title: Daily edition and specialist desks
pieces.why: The operator and daily edition must explain current work with visible uncertainty and evidence.
acceptance: The operator readback exposes the bounded mission outcome and its receipt.
A daily edition is based on actual workspace activity; stale or incomplete reads remain labelled.
Verification totals use actual review times, reset at the local date boundary and distinguish failed reads from empty activity.
Specialist desks open real tools; Living Rooms modes expose source inspection, operations, learning and retained replay.
The existing agent performs one reviewed ordinary form action with native authority and personal, account/workspace-isolated session knowledge.
Overview next actions derive only from current readable records; missing reads and demo data do not imply completed or actionable work.
Owner, Operator and Reviewer views consume one scoped value projection; current UTC-month counts retain exact readable native reviews and unknown economic baselines or denominators stay unmeasured.
The government desk is restricted to paid approved members and labels supplied research leads, synthetic demonstrations and absent model/GPU verification explicitly.

The Career Passport desk reads current scoped work and shows imported verification as reported; account/workspace changes or revocation clear private reviews, DO NOT CLAIM gaps remain visible, and imports cannot approve or submit applications.

Same-grant permission polling preserves career imports, journey drafts and assistant work while pausing new requests. Observed denial/regrant boundaries invalidate old work; already-issued command receipts may settle only in the same lifetime, and private reads/chat remain permission-gated. Polling cannot steal keyboard focus.

Pending media joins and discovery cannot revive cancelled room/account lifetimes; same-session token refresh preserves subscriptions. Structured agent detail renders as bounded inert text. The broadcast repair lesson and downloadable source-test evidence stay separate from workspace outcomes, learning completion, independent verification and deployed acceptance.

Catalogue completion derives from canonical guided states, not editable reading history; unavailable aggregates do not block individually authorized tutorials or imply zero completion. Open-book/self-reported limits, pending correction review, absent payment ingestion and claimed agent labels remain visible. The authority-repair lesson and source capture cannot create workspace outcomes or learner awards.

Browser views, failed reads, rendered degradation and validated action outcomes use bounded private section names. Receipt and lifetime checks precede success; obsolete responses, demo and cancellation cannot become backend-failure events. Native diagnostics omit personal content and stdout remains separately activated. Full coverage requires exact-release arrival in both vendors, not passing source doubles.
pieces.next_step: Run actual browser and native isolation tests, bind the existing inference endpoint under approved data authority, and observe scoped chat-to-form-to-personal-knowledge behavior. Validate value-card drill-downs against one real reviewed mission and exact provider/release receipts; collect comparable cost, effort and eligible-work baselines before displaying ROI. Exercise career export/import with the actual native account, ten real job dossiers and reviewed draft documents; obtain separate receiving authority for one permitted ATS browser submission and retain its actual receipt.

pieces.title: Sprint review - verified replay
pieces.why: Competition readiness requires an evidence-backed learning-through-work journey, a reproducible replay and actual submission criteria.
acceptance: The ordered signal-to-action-to-verification replay binds one scope, candidate and artifact.
The owner checks official judging, hosting and submission requirements against the final demonstration.
The submission package includes the exact native business receipt, all six materials and an actual official-rule capture reviewed by the selected owner.

Complete bounded mission capture uses one native read transaction and the existing action read policy, checks content and record digests, and does not confer independent verification or submission admission.

Public and submission materials identify educational collaboration as the platform, show objective, learning, collaboration, work, evidence, verification and reflection, and retain business automation as one domain with its existing acceptance requirements.
pieces.next_step: Capture one actual objective-to-reflection journey on the accepted candidate, retaining the existing business/provider lane requirements. Validate replay/native exports and all eleven owner decisions, supply six dated materials and captured official requirements, then have the owner perform submission.

external_requirements.why: GitLab executes acceptance; configured jobs and historical GitHub observations cannot establish current runner health or passing acceptance. The operator has confirmed this estate's CI is GitLab, and the stored GitHub credential returns 401, so the old GitHub billing-lock record is neither the gate nor measurable from this seat. The measured blocker on 2026-09-21 is the GitLab instance itself: its own HTTP 500 on git fetch is what failed the 09-20 jobs, in get_sources, before any test ran.
external_requirements.next_step: Restore write availability on the GitLab instance (18.8.3), then re-run project 104's pipeline and read the FIRST failure in each trace rather than the last warning - exit status 128 is git, not the test runner. Note that a write there can return 500 and still apply, so confirm by readback; a half-applied retry leaves jobs queued under a pipeline already marked failed, which never dispatches. Then verify candidate delivery and review/status integration, provision Node from .nvmrc plus Python 3.11/3.12 and declared dependencies, run every required GitLab job and retain its complete evidence export.
external_requirements.evidence_required: Actually executed GitLab job records, actor-labelled review metadata, same-candidate public statuses and all eighteen receipt/log/artifact profiles. Historical GitHub billing status does not establish GitLab health.

external_requirements.why: Merged source is not proof of an installed version or successful release.
external_requirements.next_step: The release readback now exists: the governed lane captured staging and production probes at 200 with /_version reporting the same commit on both, and evidence epochs EPOCH-20260921-01 and -02 fingerprinted the serving artifact set. What remains: bind the previous verified SHA, manifest and artifact digest before promotion, verify restoration on failure, and bind these receipts to a GitLab or Datadog export (RUM, deploy and the DORA acknowledgment) under the same SHA. See the Day-21 activation handoff.
external_requirements.evidence_required: Existing controller receipts and GitLab/Datadog exports bound to the same SHA/artifact; verified rollback target and actual restored external identity/health receipt. ROLLED_BACK_UNVERIFIED is not a successful recovery. Public sanitized references only.

external_requirements.why: Source and storage doubles do not execute the rendered application with real auth.
external_requirements.next_step: Use the locked frontend build and authorized staging accounts for desktop/mobile, retry, account-switch and resume journeys.
external_requirements.evidence_required: Dated browser evidence for the accepted candidate and route; exported-certificate previews do not count as application acceptance.

external_requirements.why: A source migration may not be installed or compatible with the running backend.
external_requirements.next_step: A disposable-profile preflight now exists and is wired: it copies the live database, runs the pinned binary against the pending set and requires the serving line, with a control proving it refuses a broken set rather than merely surviving one. It cleared 33 pending migrations onto production and one onto both environments on 2026-09-21, each confirmed by readback. Still owed: an isolation observation and an actual rollback, neither of which a preflight can establish.
external_requirements.evidence_required: Native runtime/version results plus installed migration, restart, isolation and rollback observations.

external_requirements.why: A manually authored signal does not establish live provider ingestion.
external_requirements.next_step: Capture one permitted business observation through an existing bound source and follow it into a proposed mission.
external_requirements.evidence_required: Source identity, observation time, workspace, signal and captured source observation references.

external_requirements.why: The public cockpit does not contain the private NXC/fleet executor.
external_requirements.next_step: Complete OP-00, verify the receiving dispatch/scope, read NXC, reuse one bounded staging capability and read back its result.
external_requirements.evidence_required: VCC-BUILDANDDO-OPERATOR-RUNTIME-001 scope, adapter inventory, NXC observation and actual job/result receipts.

external_requirements.why: An author's passing assertion cannot establish independent verification.
external_requirements.next_step: Inspect and replay the producer's actual result under a distinct authenticated identity.
external_requirements.evidence_required: Producer and verifier identities, observed result hash, actual checks and the final workspace evidence/readback.

external_requirements.why: Configuration and requested enablement do not establish health.
external_requirements.next_step: Bind the reviewed provider and write a fresh health observation for its current revision through the existing runtime.
external_requirements.evidence_required: Current provider/binding/configuration revision, observation time and actual readback; no credentials in exports.

external_requirements.why: A set of individually tested pages does not prove the competition journey.
external_requirements.next_step: Capture one authorized staged journey and validate its replay against the expected candidate and source fingerprint.
external_requirements.evidence_required: Ordered context, signal, proposal snapshot, approval, native or worker action, verification, evidence, reviewed outcome, operator readback and release references; synthetic captures cannot earn milestones.

external_requirements.why: The repository's internal day-21 plan is not an official competition rubric or deadline.
external_requirements.next_step: Attach the official Hostinger rules, deadline, hosting requirements and submission checklist; review the final entry against them.
external_requirements.evidence_required: Authoritative rule/source references and dated owner review; no inferred deadline or eligibility.

external_requirements.why: Source tests and a configured URL do not establish that the existing agent is available or permitted to receive workspace data.
external_requirements.next_step: Bind the approved existing endpoint/model, confirm data handling and complete native/browser plan, save, retry, revoke and personal-knowledge journeys.
external_requirements.evidence_required: Candidate-bound real inference and native save observations, permission denials for foreign accounts/workspaces, scoped citations and user session retention/forget outcomes; no secrets in exports.
